scope: Actual C2 trainer and selected original dependencies, matched four-variant TRAIN recipe, archived actual R2 CPU check evidence, and trainer smoke-to-full schema. The eight disabled smoke drafts are used to establish the real config/command schema only. This source-only report admits no deployment, smoke run, full training or benchmark.

findings.title: Full admission accepts an incomplete route witness and no checkpoint artifact
findings.evidence: The real smoke writer initializes exactly ten route keys, saves epoch_001.pth, and records its digest. The full reader checks only set(route_counts.values()) == {1} and iterates whatever artifacts entries the receipt supplies. Thus route_counts={'0':1} satisfies the route assertion, and artifacts={} skips every checkpoint hash check. This is a producer/consumer evidence-contract gap in the existing full branch, rather than a claim about any actual completed smoke.
findings.independent_reproduction: Compiled the exact load_plan AST. For each of the eight actual disabled draft schemas, constructed an in-memory finalized smoke config preserving the actual absolute command, synthetic COMPLETE/exit0 native receipt, and a synthetic future full plan/review with the normal exact binding algorithm. All eight valid full baselines pass. All eight single-route witnesses also pass, and all eight empty-artifact witnesses pass after rebinding their input byte hashes and synthetic review binding. No actual full plan or PASS review was written or admitted.
findings.minimal_required_fix: Require smoke.route_counts to equal {str(i): 1 for i in range(10)}. Require the smoke artifacts key set to equal {'epoch_001.pth'}, matching the existing smoke producer, then hash that required checkpoint under the bound smoke run. Add a full positive-path contract fixture based on the actual draft schema and negatives for a missing route and empty checkpoint map. No fallback or unrelated training change is needed.
findings.impact_boundary: Blocks approval of the trainer's claimed full smoke-evidence gate. It does not establish a failure of the current ten-update smoke training loop. Concrete smoke/operator admission is reviewed separately; full training remains unadmitted.

source_map_scope: Selected actual runtime, recipe, baseline-comparison, diagnostic and test dependencies, independently rehashed locally. This 28-entry source-only map is not either branch's 103-entry deployment closure and grants no plan binding or environment attestation.

matched_variants.assessment: Within a branch all four variants use the same exact executor/factory/manifest, causal dataset, seed, route cycle and optimizer recipe. from_e0 strictly loads the original executor before installing zero-output missing/LoRA additions. Different branches use different factory/executor inputs and are not interchangeable initialization controls. The archived R2 checker reports initial ten-route/predict equality for all four variants for the actual P25 DropMoE initialization only.

causal_TRAIN_pairs.assessment: For sorted unique valid frames, candidate search frames span the full timeline exactly when a valid predecessor exists within 200 frames. Static template is first valid; recent is strictly before search and within the inclusive 200-frame interval. Each item uses its own RandomState(seed+index), so worker scheduling and variant initialization do not change item sampling. TRAIN GT supplies the supervised search crop/target and prior template crops, as in the original dataset. This is causal temporal pair selection, not label-free online inference. No dev/test dataset is passed to the loader. Old prefix sampling remains separate.

optimizer_and_policy.assessment: model.cuda precedes collection of optimizer Parameters. The helper freezes preview/quality/gain, excludes adapter A/B from the backbone group, places decode/head/missing/A/B at 1e-4, and keeps trainable original backbone at 1e-5. Its ID-set assertion requires unique complete coverage of all trainable parameters. Frozen policy runs in eval mode and is compared tensor-for-tensor at every epoch. Independent toy-module tests exercised the actual helper for all four variants after dtype conversion. No real GPU optimizer execution is claimed.

real_training_DropPath_and_seed.assessment: The CPU diagnostic's DropPath eval override is absent from this trainer. model.train enables the original stochastic-depth recipe with maximum DROP_PATH_RATE=0.1; only policy modules and BatchNorm2d are switched to eval. A second seed_training(2027) occurs after variant installation, CUDA transfer, optimizer/scheduler and window creation, before loader iteration. It resets Python, NumPy and torch CPU/CUDA generators. CPU stream-reset tests and exact mode-statement tests passed; CUDA seeding was intercepted in the synthetic test and no GPU was accessed.
real_training_DropPath_and_seed.limit: No claim of cross-variant bitwise trained trajectory equality, cuDNN deterministic-algorithm enforcement, or equal learned model quality.

training_counts_loss_and_retention.assessment: B8, workers4, 20000 samples/epoch, 20 epochs, AdamW wd1e-4, clipping0.1, LR1e-5/1e-4 and milestone10 are fixed. Exact cycle gives ten different modality/action routes in ten smoke updates, and 50000 full updates with 5000 per route. Scheduler reduces LR for epoch11. Smoke retains epoch001; full retains exactly epochs16-20. Loss is unchanged primary localization/focal plus refined localization/focal for non-STOP routes. Inherited clamping of supervised targets outside the crop is not a new C2 behavior or evidence of recovery.

serialized_reload.assessment: The trainer serializes net/optimizer/scheduler/config/c2_config, reloads the file on CPU, compares all live net tensors against saved tensors, reconstructs the exact C2 variant and performs strict state_dict loading. The archived R2 CPU checker did not test serialized C2 training checkpoints; actual ten-update smoke must exercise this new path. Optimizer-resume parity and trained output parity are not asserted.

exact_review_plan_binding.assessment: Hashes mapped sources and every input before training, requires a SHA-bound PASS review with an identical sources map, and requires SHA256 of sorted compact JSON of every plan field except launch_allowed/review in admitted_plan_bindings. This report has an empty binding list, so it cannot authorize a run. New contract tests reject disabled/altered recipe/root/source and empty admission bindings.

actual_command_schema_correction.assessment: All eight actual disabled drafts contain the complete absolute interpreter/-B/script/--plan command. The writer serializes the entire plan, preserving command in config.json, so the full reader's config.command access is schema-compatible for these actual drafts. An earlier minimal synthetic fixture omitted command; that does not demonstrate a production draft failure and is explicitly excluded from findings. All eight real-schema full positive fixtures passed.

full_smoke_evidence.assessment: Config hash, native COMPLETE/exit0 and common task/command, recipe, source map and four original inputs are compared. Finding C2-TRAINER-R1-B1 identifies the incomplete route/key and checkpoint-presence validation. No full plan or full-training admission is present. Host/GPU/run hardening based on unspecified future full plans is not added as a separate finding.

R2_actual_CPU_evidence.independent_exit_code_limit: These five named archive documents contain actual PASS result/log and audit bindings but no separate numeric native exit-code record. The reported exit0 is the user's observation; no SSH or diagnostic rerun was used to re-attest it.
R2_actual_CPU_evidence.actual_initialization_scope: P25 DropMoE factory CADTrack_ep0020 plus executor epoch020 on one carleaves TRAIN pair at frame180; not the P26 SOT initialization.
R2_actual_CPU_evidence.reported_checks: All four variants' ten-route/predict initial equality and optimizer completeness; two finite routed CPU diagnostic updates; frozen policy equality; strict state_dict reload; CUDA uninitialized.

They do not reject missing route keys or an empty artifact map. Additional independent real-draft-schema fixtures establish that finding. Earlier 15-contract/36-total checks also passed.

full_schema_fixtures.method: Exact load_plan AST, actual eight draft structures including command and 103-entry maps, in-memory JSON tree and synthetic future reviews/bindings. Dependency hash lookups are fixture values; actual local source byte checks and archived R2 evidence checks are separate.
